entities.name: Victor Söderström
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Victor Söderström is a Swedish professional ice hockey player who is a defenceman for the Providence Bruins in the American Hockey League (AHL) while under contract to the Boston Bruins of the National Hockey League (NHL). Söderström was selected 11th overall by the Arizona Coyotes in the 2019 NHL entry draft. He also played for the Coyotes of the NHL and Brynäs IF of the Swedish Hockey League.
